searchText: What’s the timeframe for when this needs to be done? There's no real deadline for it. We'll keep doing more shadow forks till the merge, so feel free to test whenever. Hi ryg, I have successfully deployed contracts with Remix. However when I try to use truffle to deploy contracts, it always fails. Here is the error and the network config. What is the current disk requirement for mainnet state if we want to test nodes on the shadow fork? (I tried responding to <@!199561711278227457>’s relevant post in <#892088344438255616> but it’s read-only?) ^ same as any mainnet node, so ~500gb-750gb to be safe. The nodes i provisioned are 1tb just to leave enough headroom Not sure about that. Have not tried truffle with the public RPC. can someone help me understand what this latest talk about shadowing/shadow-testing means? have we moved away from going to "the merge" each of our testnet(s) and then finally mainnet? No, that is the next step after the shadow forks
